title: Tears or Cheers? Benchmarking LLMs via Culturally Elicited Distinct Affective Responses

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model predictions of emotional responses to identical multimodal and text-only scenarios across seven languages, comparing the outputs against culture-specific native-speaker ground truths to measure cross-cultural alignment and interpretative variance.
Assessing performance disparities and English-centric advantages by comparing model accuracy when prompted in various native languages versus English across the dataset.

Measuring Emotion Prediction Propensity (EPP) and Russell's Quadrant Bias (RQB) to quantify the systematic tendency of models to over-predict high-arousal, salient emotions while under-predicting deactivated, subtle emotional states.
